customer: Can I just drop by a store to get my coupe appraised, or do I need to book ahead? Between classes my schedule's tight, so how long does it take?
agent: No appointment needed. You can walk into any Northwind store and get a quote on the spot. A specialist inspects your car while you wait, usually in 30 to 45 minutes, and you'll get a written quote that's valid for 7 days or 300 miles. If you decide to accept, you can finish the sale during the same visit, so bring your photo ID, registration and title, or your payoff information if you still have a loan.
